tests: the compiled plugin appends to the tool-call log and never reads it

dangerousStates.replace: import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";

consumesExternalOutput.program: tsc, run over the plugin sources so the assertion is over emitted JavaScript
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The compiled output is produced inside the test by the pinned tsc in node_modules and read back, so the assertion is over emit rather than over source. The cited capture is the harness contract that makes the observer a pure appender in the first place.
